title: squalify must keep descriptors compact for wide files
lead: Shrinks the evidence trail and repeated field lists before the schema freeze. Descriptors for files with a few hundred columns reached several hundred KB, mostly per-field evidence repeating type votes and long name lists.
boundary: **Not in this slice:** shrinking field profiles; compressing the output; an optional compact output mode.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Goals: a stable schema (this changes shapes, so it lands before sq-12) and output that consumers can store and diff.

Sample-data review (2026-10-13, finding 14), adopted by the owner: wide files gave descriptors of several hundred KB, mostly per-field evidence repeating unanimous type votes and long field-name lists. That evidence adds nothing a consumer cannot read from the field's `type` and `typeVotes`. Grouping it keeps the descriptor proportional to what is unusual in the file.

Owner decision (2026-10-13): no whole-descriptor size budget; the test checks only what this slice changes, the evidence section's growth with field count.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- Evidence (stage `type`): a per-field entry only when the votes are not unanimous. Fields whose votes are unanimous are listed in one entry per type: `{ stage: "type", topic: "unanimous", chosen: "<type>", fields: [indexes] }`.
- Hints: `nonNullFields` becomes ascending field indexes; `headerFields` keeps names (DataBall matches on them).
- `docs/descriptor.md` `evidence` and `hints`; `docs/design.md` "Evidence trail".

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
1. `Evidence_Unanimous_Grouped`: a file with 200 unanimous float fields and one mixed field gives one grouped entry and one per-field entry.
2. `Evidence_Size_GrowsOnlyByIndexList`: synthetic padded fixtures with 50 and 250 unanimous columns (same types, same rows). The serialized `evidence` section of the 250-column descriptor exceeds the 50-column one by no more than the extra index digits and separators (at most 6 bytes per extra field).
3. Every golden is re-recorded, and the diff is reviewed.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the tests.
2. Implement the grouping, then the hint indexes.
3. Mutation check: write per-field entries for unanimous fields, and test 2 must go red.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `dotnet build squalify.sln -c Release`
- `dotnet test squalify.sln -c Release`
- `dotnet format squalify.sln --verify-no-changes`
- If this slice changed architecture (the pipeline, an interface, a descriptor section or a determinism rule), `docs/how-it-works.md` and its diagrams are updated and `./scripts/render-docs.sh` has been re-run. The architect confirms there is no drift.
- `slicer check`

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Worktree `.worktrees/sq-20` on branch `sq-20`. No agent commits. After the gate returns `VERDICT: PASS`, the orchestrator commits `sq-20: compact evidence` when the owner approves.
